summary: Broad frontend verification of day/night theme feature across storefront (home, shop, product, cart, checkout, journal, passport, legal) in BOTH light and dark modes, plus toggle behaviour, persistence across reload+navigation, logo swap, and age-gate/Launching-Soon popup theming on a fresh session. 7/8 pages fully pass in light mode; dark mode is 100% intact. Toggle + localStorage persistence + logo swap all verified. ONE critical readability bug found: the Age Gate hero heading 'Are you 21 or older?' is invisible in light mode (cream text on cream background). RCA is a stray global override in index.css.

ui_bugs.issue: In LIGHT mode the h1 heading renders with color rgb(244,238,225) = #F4EEE1 (cream) on background rgb(234,225,208) = #EAE1D0 (also cream). Contrast ratio ≈ 1.05:1 — heading is effectively invisible. Dark mode is fine (white on #0A0A0A). Same issue also washes-out the 'EST. 2026 / INDIA'S FIRST' footer inside the age-gate.

issues: The 'ADMIN' link uses text-white/25 which the theme-light remap turns into rgba(38,32,26,0.32) on cream — legible but low-contrast (~3.1:1). Non-blocking.
Recurring console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute...' — non-blocking, carried over from iteration 8.

action_items: Fix AgeGate light-mode invisibility: root cause is /app/frontend/src/index.css line 372 → '.theme-light .bg-[#0A0A0A] { color: #F4EEE1 !important; }'. This rule was intended only for 'dark buttons' to keep light text, but the AgeGate root wrapper (components/AgeGate.js line 19: className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white ...") also matches. In light mode line 347 remaps bg-[#0A0A0A] to background #EAE1D0 (cream) AND line 372 forces text color to #F4EEE1 (cream) → invisible heading. Recommended fix (one of): (a) narrow the selector on line 372 to buttons only, e.g. '.theme-light button.bg-\[\#0A0A0A\]' or add class '.dark-btn' explicitly and target that, (b) drop the !important and remove line 372 entirely (headline inherits text-white which is already remapped to #26201A), or (c) change AgeGate wrapper to use a theme-agnostic wrapper (e.g. bg-[var(--surface)]) so the light theme picks up the correct ink automatically. Option (b) is the smallest, safest change.
Optional: bump ADMIN footer link contrast in light mode (use text-white/40 or text-white/50 instead of text-white/25).
critical_code_review_comments: index.css line 372 '.theme-light .bg-[#0A0A0A] { color: #F4EEE1 !important }' is a very broad selector using !important that overrides the well-scoped text-white remap. Any component using bg-[#0A0A0A] as an overlay/panel (not a button) will suffer inverted contrast in light mode. Consider replacing utility-class-based remaps with CSS variables (--bg, --ink) applied at the theme root to avoid this class of bug entirely.

AgeGate.js and LaunchCountdown.js hardcode dark palette classes (bg-[#0A0A0A], text-white/N) instead of using theme tokens. They currently work by accident of the remap; a single mis-scoped rule (as above) breaks them.

success_rate.frontend: 94% (16/17 assertions) — toggle, persistence (reload+nav), logo swap, light readability on 7 of 7 storefront pages, dark integrity on 8 of 8 pages, countdown popup themed correctly. Age-gate heading readability in light mode FAILED.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Toggle path + persistence works: clicking [data-testid=theme-toggle] flips document.documentElement between 'theme-light'/'theme-dark' and writes 'light'|'dark' to localStorage key 'ccc_theme_override'. Both survive reload and route change. Logo src swaps between /brand-assets/logos/cosmos-seal-dark.png (light mode) and /brand-assets/logos/cosmos-seal.png (dark mode). To bypass gate for readability tests: localStorage.setItem('ccc_age_ok','true'); sessionStorage.setItem('ccc_countdown_seen','true'). Age-gate + countdown popup theming test was performed on cleared storage. After main agent fixes the AgeGate readability bug, re-verify by clearing all storage, setting ccc_theme_override='light', loading '/' — the h1 'Are you 21 or older?' must be dark ink (#26201A-ish) on cream, and the Yes/No buttons must remain readable.
rca of the issue: AgeGate root wrapper uses tailwind class bg-[#0A0A0A]. In light mode, /app/frontend/src/index.css has TWO rules for this class: line 347 remaps its background to cream #EAE1D0 (correct), but line 372 additionally forces color:#F4EEE1 !important (intended only for solid-dark button chips, per the inline comment). The color override wins over text-white's remap and cascades into the h1. Result: cream heading on cream background → 1.05:1 contrast. Reproduction: clear storage → localStorage.setItem('ccc_theme_override','light') → reload → the age-gate loads with the giant title invisible while the red 'YES, I AM 21+' button and the small paragraph (text-white/50, remapped by lines 353–360) remain readable. Mitigation: see action_items — remove or narrow line 372 of index.css.
